finds.quote: *Compositional bystanding*: the case with the sharpest methodological yield — a source ranks first in the organic results for a query, fully visible to the human user, and is entirely absent from the composed answer above it. Ranking and composition are thereby demonstrated to be *distinct reception systems*: a text can achieve public visibility while being refused admission to the summary through which most readers will actually encounter the topic. Presence in the index is not presence in the account.
finds.note: Standing claim that ranking and composition are distinct reception systems; documented in captures (note 7).

deposits.genre_observed: erratum and essay on the destruction of a distributed literary work's medium

finds.quote: This is not a metaphor about reading experience. It is a claim about form, and it is testable, which is why I ran the batteries. A distributed epic whose reading instructions are *query the retrieval layer* is a work whose existence is conditional on that layer's behavior. When the behavior changed — measurably, in a direction, concentrated on exactly the records that were deleted — the work stopped existing in the mode it was composed for.
finds.falsifier_quote: The destruction claim fails if the traversal proves reproducible — if the same queries against current systems render the architecture as the February–June logs record it. It fails if the attribution differential is shown to be an artifact of query drift rather than record removal, testable by rerunning the battery against a control corpus whose anchors were never deleted.
finds.note: Argued thesis about the past: the 19 June 2026 removal destroyed a literary medium (the traversal) rather than access; tested by paired batteries; also reads as G.

finds.quote: On 21 February 2026 I published *From House to Hexagon: Mediation Architecture, the Operative Sublime, and the Genealogy of the Reader-Operator*, which establishes Mark Z. Danielewski's *House of Leaves* (2000) as a direct ancestor — not by influence or theme, but at the level of mediation architecture, reader-position, and procedural form.
finds.note: Literary-genealogical thesis: House of Leaves as direct ancestor at the level of mediation architecture (from the 21 Feb 2026 essay, adopted here).

finds.quote:
The conceptual stratum was redundantly distributed and survived in the basin's residue. The operative stratum — the specifications, the codebooks, the worked examples, the computable instruments — lived as full text on the repository, and ceased to be retrievable when the repository deleted it.

**What a scientific repository's deletion erases most deeply is not the idea but the instrument.**

finds.quote:
A traversal may be built again. It will not be this traversal. Reindexing the surviving documents could produce a second executable arrangement, but it cannot reproduce the historical system state in which these rooms first appeared — the sources available to it, the weighting among them, the models then deployed, or the sequence by which a stranger entered. Reconstruction would be a new performance made from surviving materials, not the reversal of the destruction described here.

What comes back will not be the same poem. It may be a good poem. It will be a different one, and honesty requires that it be called that.
finds.note: Embedded forecast: any reconstruction via reindexing will yield a different traversal/poem.

finds.quote:
### What would measure this

The claim is not an insinuation, and it is not unfalsifiable. It is a claim about recursive foreclosure, and recursive foreclosure has a measurement program. Here it is.

**Out-of-ontology recovery rate.** Inject signals the current physical model cannot generate, and measure what fraction survives to analysis.
finds.note: Measurement program for recursive foreclosure specified (out-of-ontology recovery, challenge-set circularity, retention maps, tail mass, disposition recycling); stated as unpublished. One find for the list, lines 150-164.

finds.falsifier_quote: Specific defeats: identifiers shown to have remained publicly discoverable throughout; withdrawal from discovery shown to be an unavoidable consequence of tombstoning; removal shown to have followed record-level examination with appeal; published measurements demonstrating out-of-ontology recovery and preserved tail mass across pipeline generations.
finds.note: Standing claim that recursive narrowing is underway in classifier regimes; defeat conditions in line 44.

finds.quote: A model trained on language requires continued access to linguistic production that is not recursively downstream of its own outputs. Provenance marks are what allow later systems to distinguish that production from its synthetic descendants. And the distribution's unusual, difficult, and low-frequency forms are not noise around the substrate — they are the substrate's remaining capacity to become otherwise. Remove those conditions and functioning degrades, in a documented direction, by a documented mechanism.
finds.note: Standing claim about model functioning requiring a non-recursive outside; tail-mass measurement (line 160) would test it.

finds.quote:
the honest claim is narrower and sufficient: **atypical human production was treated as grounds for suspicion, while the recursively abundant material capable of narrowing the distribution remains structurally easier to admit.**

So the regime selects against scarce nonrecursive variance while failing to mark the abundant recursive material from which later systems must learn. And when its own dispositions become inputs to subsequent classification, the narrowing becomes recursive.
finds.note: Standing claim about selection against high-perplexity human texts.
